chunks: The Christ, son of Mary, was but an apostle, and many apostles had (come and) gone before him; and his mother was a woman of truth. They both ate the (same) food (as men). Behold, how We show men clear signs, and behold, how they wander astray!
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about Jesus and Mary eating food?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse serves as a foundational proof for the humanity of Jesus (peace be upon him), emphasizing that his eating food signifies his natural mortality and distinguishes him from divine entities. It underscores the rational argument that if he were God, he would not require sustenance, thereby refuting the Christian doctrine of divinity while affirming his status as a chosen messenger. This narrative reinforces the concept of *Tawhid* (Oneness of God) by presenting clear, observable signs that the people often distort or overlook.
